_about: Ulrich von Wilamowitz-Moellendorff (1848-1931). His one English book before 1930: the 1908 Oxford lectures, translated by Gilbert Murray. His German works are out of scope for this English shelf.

wilamowitz-greek-historical-writing-apol: Greek Historical Writing, and Apollo: two lectures delivered before the University of Oxford, June 3 and 4, 1908, tr. Gilbert Murray
